title: Do Multilingual Large Language Models Mitigate Stereotype Bias?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the CrowS-Pairs benchmark (comparing pseudo-log-likelihood of stereotyping vs. anti-stereotyping sentence pairs) and the BBQ benchmark (multiple-choice question answering to measure reliance on stereotypes in ambiguous vs. disambiguated contexts).
